summary: Verified end-to-end the two new search enhancements: (1) typeable WherePicker autocomplete on Home (/) and /stays — replaces the prior read-only select; (2) two-month WhenPicker calendar on mobile (390x844). All 11 acceptance criteria from the request pass. Legacy testids hero-where-select / stays-where-select are removed. Substring filter on /stays works: 'ame' yields 5 American-Colony cards, 'jeru' yields 14 Jerusalem-prefixed cards, 'xyz123' shows the empty-state and hides the dropdown. URL persistence works (?area=ame survives reload). On mobile, the home When popover renders exactly 2 .rdp-month elements (bbox width 367 in a 390 viewport — no horizontal overflow). Range selection on the smaller mobile cells still produces .rdp-day_range_start / .rdp-day_range_end / .rdp-day_range_middle and Apply closes the popover and updates the trigger to 'Jun 30 – Jul 4'. Desktop still shows 2 months — no regression.

stays_when_mobile_390x844.stays_when_trigger_in_filters_modal: NOT rendered — modal uses native <input type='date'> instead
stays_when_mobile_390x844.note: On mobile /stays there is NO path to the new WhenPicker calendar. This matches iteration_28 design choice but means the mobile 2-month layout on /stays is technically not user-reachable today. Home (/) on mobile DOES expose it via hero-when-trigger and the 2-month layout works perfectly there.

critical_code_review_comments: WherePicker.jsx (line 64): typing in the input calls onChange with the raw text — fine for the Stays substring filter, but the value stored is the raw query string (e.g. 'ame'), not a canonical area name. When users come back to /stays?area=ame and bookmark/share, the URL is human-unfriendly. Consider syncing to the full area name on suggestion click but keeping raw input otherwise (this is actually current behavior — just calling it out).

WherePicker.jsx: no keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter) for the suggestions list. Users can only mouse-click options. Recommend adding aria-activedescendant + arrow-key handling for accessibility / a11y compliance.
WherePicker.jsx: the <input> has no aria-autocomplete / aria-expanded / role='combobox' attributes — screen readers will not announce it as a combobox. Minor a11y improvement.

whenpicker.css line 17: `--rdp-cell-size: 26px` on mobile makes day-cell tap targets ~26x26px, which is below the WCAG 2.5.5 minimum of 24x24 (just barely) and well below the recommended 44x44. Functionally testable in Playwright but users with motor impairments may mis-tap. Consider increasing tap target padding via .rdp-day { padding: 4px } without growing the cell.

Stays.jsx mobile: the /stays page renders the WhenPicker inside StaysSearchBar but hides the When segment at the sm breakpoint and falls back to native date inputs inside Filters modal. The new 2-month-on-mobile work is therefore unreachable on /stays mobile. Either (a) expose stays-when-trigger on mobile (matching Home), or (b) document that the 2-month mobile improvement is Home-only.

WherePicker.jsx line 96: data-testid uses `opt.replace(/\s+/g, '-')` which produces ugly testids like `hero-where-option-Jerusalem---American-Colony` (note the triple dashes from ' - '). Functional but consider a slug helper that collapses runs of non-alphanumerics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WherePicker autocomplete + WhenPicker 2-month mobile both pass. Key data points: (a) Seed inventory has 14 properties, all Jerusalem-area; typing 'ame' yields 5 American Colony cards, 'jeru' yields all 14, 'tel' or 'xyz' yields 0 and the empty-state. (b) 'today' on the preview is ~Jun 28 2026 — picking days[2] and days[6] from the enabled-day list gave Jun 30 – Jul 4. (c) On mobile (390x844), .rdp-airbnb --rdp-cell-size shrinks to 26px via @media (max-width:639px). Popover bbox is exactly 367px wide. (d) IMPORTANT: /stays on mobile does NOT expose the WhenPicker — it falls back to native date inputs inside the Filters modal. The new 2-month layout is reachable only from Home (/) on mobile. (e) URL param is `?area=<raw>` where <raw> is the literal input text, not a normalized area name; case-insensitive substring filter on the Stays side resolves it. (f) data-testid pattern for option buttons is `${testidPrefix}-option-${optWithSpacesAsHyphens}` — note multiple consecutive hyphens for ' - '.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no bugs. Implementation matches the spec: typeable input + substring autocomplete + URL sync, and a CSS-driven 2-month mobile calendar. The only spec ambiguity is whether the 2-month mobile rule should ALSO be reachable from /stays mobile (it currently is not, by an older design choice — see code review comment 5).
